title: Finish five-domain router-to-application boundaries without further mechanical splitting
summary: Remediated all 5 reviewer rejection acceptance failures from Codex2 on PR #5992 exact head 871586492e6663ea485a3f198fe24bf050bfda68: (1) Defect 1 (KW04 contracts in research domain): Restored KW04 validations in research/service.py so linked_entity_ref without linked_entity_type returns 400 (precondition_failed='linked_entity_ref'), confidence_min outside [0.0, 1.0] returns 400, status='all' preserves all rows (active/archived) instead of filtering literal 'all', and linked_sources matching requires entity_type and entity_ref on the same source item; passed test_kw04_insight_cards_contract.py (3/3 passed) and added regression tests in test_bff_test_architecture.py. (2) Defect 2 (Dynamic forwarder _ResearchPortAdapter.__getattr__): Replaced _ResearchPortAdapter.__getattr__ with typed ResearchPortWiring(ResearchKnowledgeSourcePort) defining explicit domain-specific typed delegation for all 39 port methods and conditional binding for optional store methods without __getattr__, __getattribute__, _active_delegate, or mock-module special casing; verified runtime probe service._port().unrelated_operation() strictly raises AttributeError. (3) Defect 3 (Promotion decision & ranking orchestration in PersonaService): Moved promotion decision policy, revision resolution, and command dispatch from personas/routes/ranking.py into PersonaService.decide_promotion_review, and ranking/evidence/snapshot persistence/recommendation orchestration into PersonaService.get_quarterly_ranking_recommendations, leaving HTTP router handlers to parse, invoke authorization, and map DTO/status. (4) Defect 4 (Typed store contracts across domains): Replaced Any-containing unions and untyped parameters in agora/research/service.py (store: Union[MemoryResearchPlanStore, PostgresResearchPlanStore], workshop_store: Optional[Union[MemoryWorkshopStore, PostgresWorkshopStore]], dataset_store: Optional[AgoraDatasetStore], trading_room_store: Optional[TradingRoomStore]) and agora/trading_room/service.py (workshop_store: Optional[Union[MemoryWorkshopStore, PostgresWorkshopStore]]), establishing concrete typed store contracts across all five domains. (5) Defect 5 (AST gate & negative cases): Extended scan_route_source_for_store_access to detect __getattr__/__getattribute__ definitions and dynamic variable getattr(target, var), extended test_five_domain_routers_have_no_direct_store_access to scan all 5 application service files while preserving legitimate owner store access, and added negative regression tests and KW04 contract regression tests in test_bff_test_architecture.py.
